rules.description: claude-in-chrome deferred-tool loading: redirect claude-in-chrome -> OCC (split from browser-automation)
stock: If the mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load every tool you expect to need in ONE ToolSearch call — the select query accepts a comma-separated list — never one call per tool. Start with the core set:

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting.
unnerf: The mcp__open-claude-in-chrome__* tools can be deferred. A deferred tool must be loaded through ToolSearch before you use it. Load every tool you expect to need in ONE ToolSearch call. The select query accepts a comma-separated list. Do not load tools one at a time. Start with the core set:

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task needs them: read_console_messages or read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting.
